_source_notes: Dimensional values follow the Harmonised Guidelines and Standards for Universal Accessibility in India (2021, MoHUA) and IRC:103-2012 Guidelines for Pedestrian Facilities. Footpath clear width 1.8 m minimum (IRC:103 cl. 5.2; HG 2021 §3.1), kerb height 150 mm maximum (IRC:103 cl. 5.4), ramp gradient 1:12 maximum with 1:20 preferred (HG 2021 §3.4), kerb ramp flare 1:10, vertical level change tolerated without bevel 6 mm and with bevel up to 12 mm (HG 2021 §3.2), cross-fall 1:50 maximum, tactile guiding and warning tiles mandatory at crossings and hazards (HG 2021 §3.6). Costs are indicative 2025 Delhi rates for scoping only.

authorities.MCD: Municipal Corporation of Delhi — footpath surface, encroachment, sanitation
authorities.PWD: Public Works Department — arterial road footpaths, ramps, railings, crossings
authorities.DJB: Delhi Jal Board — drain covers, manholes, sewer lines
authorities.DISCOM: BSES / TPDDL — street lighting, poles, transformers
authorities.Traffic Police: Delhi Traffic Police — illegal parking on footpaths

MCD.label: MCD online grievance (MCD 311)
MCD.how: Register a grievance under Public Grievance, or use the MCD 311 app. Attach the photo and paste the complaint draft.

PWD.label: PWD Delhi public grievance
PWD.how: Use the Public Grievance link. For arterial road footpaths, name the road and the nearest landmark.

DJB.label: Delhi Jal Board complaints
DJB.how: Open drains, missing covers and manholes. Helpline 1916 also logs complaints with a reference number.

DISCOM.label: BSES / Tata Power-DDL
DISCOM.how: BSES for south and east Delhi, Tata Power-DDL (tatapower-ddl.com) for north and north-west. Poles, transformers and street lighting.

Traffic Police.label: Delhi Traffic Police
Traffic Police.how: Vehicles parked on footpaths. The Traffic Sentinel app accepts a photo with location.

_any.label: Delhi Government PGMS
_any.how: Public Grievance Monitoring System: routes a complaint to any Delhi department and gives a tracking number. CPGRAMS (pgportal.gov.in) works for central agencies.
